notes: DeepFlux 8.6 - System Health fixes. The per-disk read/write speeds in the System Health tab now show real live numbers (a wrong Windows query code made them always read 0 B/s in 8.5), and the tab's sampling code was hardened. If 8.5 closed when you opened the System Health tab, please try this build - and if it still closes, the app's crash log (AppData\Local\DeepFlux\faulthandler.log) now holds the exact line to report.
